data.name: TURBO
data.detailed_description:
Turbo is an anime-inspired top-down 3D pixel art action RPG that plunges you into a dark, philosophical, and psychological multiverse. Explore vibrant, open-ended worlds filled with puzzles, mysteries, and morally complex choices, where every action and decision shapes your journey.

  • Battle of Wits System: Engage in duels of intellect using the dialogue system—outsmart enemies and rivals with clever responses, manipulation, and strategy. Words can be as powerful as weapons.

  • Free-Flow Combat & Martial Arts Mastery: Fight using a wide variety of martial arts, from Jeet Kune Do, Taekwondo, Muay Thai, to Karate. Combine skill, timing, and strategy to chain devastating combos.

  • Parkour & Grapple Hook Traversal: Swing, climb, and navigate environments fluidly, exploring every corner of sprawling worlds with freedom and verticality.

  • Branching Narrative & 88-Character Cast: Every character has their own story, motivations, and dark themes, making each choice impactful and every interaction meaningful.

  • Detective Gameplay & Puzzles: Investigate mysteries, manipulate objects, interrogate characters, and solve intricate environmental and logic-based puzzles.

  • Immersive, Vibrant Worlds: Explore colorful, open-ended multiverse regions, uncover hidden secrets, and experience environments that react to your actions.

Dive into Turbo’s interconnected multiverse, where dialogue duels, martial arts combat, parkour, and detective work collide in an immersive, thought-provoking experience. Every world hides secrets, every character tells a story, and every choice challenges your mind—and your morals.

Features

  • Top-down 3D pixel art visuals with vibrant colors and immersive environments.

  • Free-flow combat combining multiple martial arts styles: Jeet Kune Do, Taekwondo, Muay Thai, Karate.

  • Battle of Wits system for dialogue duels and strategic conversations.

  • Grapple hook and parkour traversal across sprawling open-ended worlds.

  • Branching narrative with 108 characters, each with unique stories and dark, mature themes.

  • Detective system with physical interaction: investigate, interrogate, manipulate objects.

  • Complex environmental and logic-based puzzles.

  • Multiverse exploration with portals connecting diverse, detailed worlds.

  • Choices affect story outcomes and character interactions.

  • Highly replayable with multiple story paths and secrets to uncover.

data.short_description: Turbo is a top-down 3D pixel art action RPG set in a dark, philosophical multiverse. Master free-flow combat, duel enemies with the Battle of Wits dialogue system, teleport across worlds, solve mysteries with detective gameplay, puzzles, and explore 108 characters branching, morally complex stories.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4430
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • Additional Notes: A potato PC will do

content_descriptors.notes: Turbo will have alot of violence throughout the game as the game has free flow combat that will make use of that and more gameplay systems where it will be focused on such as torture scenes. The violence will be graphic as this is an action game, however it wont be intense for most viewers as the intent is to convey the theme and support the themes represented in the game. The non-explicit sexual content will be showcased to bring awareness to the themes being represented. It will be a very important story line however all themes and concepts illustrated in the game is to bring awareness to players.
